title: Consumer Insights & Personalization Engine
thesis: Snowflake ingests consumer behavior from Kinesis, classifies purchase intent with ML.CLASSIFICATION, generates personalized content via Cortex Complete, and delivers offers through SES — replacing Amazon Personalize with native capabilities

talking_points: 2.8 million active customers — average CLV of ₱24,500 across all segments.
ML-personalized campaigns: 2.4x higher conversion vs static campaigns.
342,000 customers classified as churn risk — ₱8.4B in CLV at stake.
show: Show personalized vs static conversion comparison
tabs.call_out: ₱8.4B CLV at risk from 342K churn-risk customers

transition.line: Let's see how personalization retains these customers.

talking_points: ML.CLASSIFICATION predicts purchase intent for 2.8M customers — refreshed hourly.
Cortex Complete generates personalized email copy: 'Based on your recent purchase of...'
Click-through rate: 8.4% for ML-personalized vs 3.5% for segment-based (2.4x lift).
tabs.call_out: 2.4x conversion lift — ML personalization vs segment-based targeting

transition.line: The engine works. Let's look at the customer segments.

talking_points: Five segments: VIP (top 5%), Loyal (20%), Active (35%), At-Risk (25%), Dormant (15%).
VIP segment CLV: ₱142,000 — worth 5.8x the average customer.
At-Risk segment responds best to loyalty point bonuses (23% reactivation rate).
tabs.call_out: VIP worth 5.8x average — protect at all costs

transition.line: Let the VP ask the system directly.

talking_points: Clarissa asks: 'What's the best offer for at-risk VIP customers?'
Cortex Analyst: Free shipping + 500 bonus points — drove 34% retention in last campaign.
Follow-up: 'Generate email copy for this offer' — Cortex Complete writes personalized message.
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL analytics + content generation

talking_points: Kinesis → Snowpipe → Customer 360 → ML scoring → Cortex Complete copy → SES delivery.
Replaces Amazon Personalize + SageMaker + Bedrock with native Snowflake.
Philippine retail: ₱4.2T market. This personalizes for 2.8M customers hourly.
tabs.call_out: Ingest → Score → Generate → Deliver — one platform, one SQL pipeline

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Philippine retail personalization.
